findings: Held-out clean accuracy is 100.000000% against the prospective 99% target.
Held-out 10 dB active-tone-SNR, independent +/-1.5% offset accuracy is 99.902344% against the prospective 95% target.
Maximum accepted hard-set latency from received-signal onset is 50.000 ms; channel transients and 5 ms onset blocks may exceed the 40 ms prospective target.
Gray-region durations 24-39 ms are reported as output counts but excluded from every conformance accuracy and confusion denominator.

frozen_protocol.active_tone_snr: One realized Gaussian sequence is normalized so its mean-square over the known source-active interval gives exactly the requested ratio to signal-only mean-square at the receiver input after optional channel convolution; the same noise scale is then applied to the whole episode, including pauses.
frozen_protocol.channel: The committed 101-tap synthetic 300-3400 Hz course FIR; it is enabled on a deterministic subset of training, hard held-out, and spectral negative trials.
frozen_protocol.confusion_normalization: Raw 17x17 counts use the frozen label order; each normalized row is divided by its true-label count. Gray trials and training trials are excluded from the combined held-out confusion matrix.
frozen_protocol.independence: Every valid impaired trial draws low offset, high offset, low phase, high phase, and twist separately from its split's LCG stream. Held-out streams have distinct seeds and are never read during threshold search.
frozen_protocol.prng: Before every uniform draw: s=(1664525*s+1013904223) mod 2^32; u=(s+0.5)/2^32. Gaussian noise uses two successive u values in the Box-Muller transform, with its second normal cached.

spectral_measurement.detuning_probe: After nominal row/column winners are selected, direct correlations scan physical frequencies from -4% to +4% in 0.25-percentage-point steps around each winner.
spectral_measurement.nominal_correlations: C(f)=sum_{n=0}^{159} x[n] exp(-j*2*pi*f*n/8000) evaluated directly at each of the eight physical nominal frequencies; these are not ordinary FFT bins
spectral_measurement.record: last 160 samples (20 ms) before temporal qualification

temporal_receiver.duration_gate: at least a 40 ms candidate span with at least 30 ms above threshold
temporal_receiver.gray_duration_ms: strictly >23 and <40; locally allowed to reject but excluded from conformance scoring
temporal_receiver.interruption_gate: at most 10 ms of consecutive sub-threshold blocks inside a candidate
temporal_receiver.latency_origin: first signal-only sample at the receiver input; decision is at the boundary of the first qualified 40 ms candidate span
temporal_receiver.pause_gate: at least 40 ms of consecutive sub-threshold 5 ms blocks before onset

frozen_protocol.threshold_selection: Training only. First maximize mean positive-detection/temporal-negative-rejection over block-energy candidates. Then maximize 17-label macro recall, tie-breaking by worst of key/reject accuracy, reject accuracy, and finally earliest frozen candidate. No held-out result participates.
frozen_protocol.tone_amplitude: Low-group amplitude is uniform on [0.26,0.34); high-group amplitude equals low amplitude times 10^(twist_dB/20).

gray_duration_excluded.exclusion_reason: Durations strictly greater than 23 ms and strictly less than 40 ms are an unspecified profile gray region.
